flagged: F003: The top view centers the opening transversely; section A-A shows it breaking through the shaft. Start and finish beyond the OD envelope to avoid coincident cut limits.

F005: Section A-A places the recess floor .500 below the upper OD crown. Cutting upward from that floor beyond the OD gives the exact recess depth. Transverse centering is explicitly called out; axial centering on the inner opening is not imposed.

F006: The outer recess corners are visibly rounded, but the leader terminates on the inner opening. D005 is a candidate only; do not execute this fillet until its applicability is confirmed. F005 is an intermediate sharp-corner recess, not a claim that the finished recess has square corners. DEFAULT D7: general/TYP callout applied to the planned edges

F007: Use the conventional Unified 1-1/2-12 tap-drill chart size 1-27/64 inch (1.421875). The modeled flat-bottom bore extends to the specified tapped depth; uncalled-for drill-point geometry and additional manufacturing drilling allowance are not added.

F008: For the D018 = .500 SHCS, the supplied ASME B18.3 normal-fit SHCS chart gives .531 clearance drill and .812 counterbore diameter. The printed D017 depth overrides the chart's default head-seat depth. Section A-A shows the clearance passage terminating in the transverse opening, not continuing into the left web; D005 provides overshoot into that opening.

F009: The standard tap drill for 3/8-16 UNC is 5/16 inch (.3125). Model the specified tapped extent as a flat-bottom cosmetic-thread bore without adding unspecified drilling allowances. End-view coordinates are relative to the shaft axis, not its bounding-box corner.
F010: The right end view shows mirror-image hole locations about both centerlines, giving coordinates (±D019, ±D020).
